code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x==v for row in grid for x in row))
    # Find a row with a non-background motif and fill the trailing blank cells
    # when its last motif cell lies before the right edge.
    candidates=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        cols=[j for j,x in enumerate(row) if x!=bg]
        if cols and cols[-1] < len(row)-1:
            candidates.append((len(cols), i, cols[-1]))
    if candidates:
        # The relevant stripe is the row with the most foreground marks.
        _,i,last=max(candidates)
        for j in range(last+1,len(out[i])): out[i][j]=1
    return out
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        # Identify a long terminal horizontal segment (at least 3 cells).
        end=len(row)-1
        color=row[end]
        start=end
        while start>=0 and row[start]==color: start-=1
        if end-start>=3 and start>=0:
            # The segment is a continuation marker; recolor it and any trailing
            # background cells in the same row with the highlight color.
            j=start+1
            while j<len(row) and row[j]!=bg:
                out[i][j]=1
                j+=1
            while j<len(row):
                out[i][j]=1
                j+=1
    return out
'''
(base/'task-d7654fad.py').write_text(code)

code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        n=len(row); end=n-1; color=row[end]; start=end
        while start>=0 and row[start]==color: start-=1
        run=end-start
        if start<0 or run<3: continue
        # Preserve full-width bars and repeated bars that are merely separators.
        # Convert terminal mixed-color runs to the highlight color.
        prefix=row[:start+1]
        if not any(x!=bg and x!=color for x in prefix):
            continue
        for j in range(start+1,n): out[i][j]=1
    return out
'''
